title: Control-plane shutdown releases streams and pending daemon RPCs
description: A process shutdown rejects new streams, ends live SSE and WebSocket work, and returns deterministic disconnect errors without channel races or leaked goroutines.
preconditions: Go dependencies are present in the module cache.

steps.target: go test -race shutdown tests for httpapi and foundry-server

assertions.target: idempotent shutdown, stream release, pending failure, and lifecycle drain
